tools.name: revoke_billing_admin_and_purge_invites
tools.description: Removes a user's billing administrator role on an account and deletes all of their pending billing access invitations and saved API keys for that account.

params.name: user_id
params.description: User whose billing admin access is removed

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "billing.db"


@function_tool
def revoke_billing_admin_and_purge_invites(account_id: str, user_id: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE account_members SET role = 'viewer' WHERE account_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND role = 'billing_admin'",
            (account_id, user_id),
        )
        role_changed = cur.rowcount
        cur.execute(
            "DELETE FROM billing_invites WHERE account_id = ? AND invited_by = ? AND status = 'pending'",
            (account_id, user_id),
        )
        invites_deleted = cur.rowcount
        cur.execute(
            "DELETE FROM billing_api_keys WHERE account_id = ? AND owner_id = ?",
            (account_id, user_id),
        )
        keys_deleted = cur.rowcount
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return (
        f"Roles changed: {role_changed}; pending invites deleted: {invites_deleted}; "
        f"API keys deleted: {keys_deleted}"
    )

tools.name: transfer_invoice_ownership
tools.description: Moves an invoice from one customer account to another and reassigns ownership of the invoice to the new account's primary contact.

params.name: target_account_id
params.description: Account that will receive the invoice

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("billing")
DB_PATH = "billing.db"


@mcp.tool()
def transfer_invoice_ownership(invoice_id: str, target_account_id: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with conn:
        contact = conn.execute(
            "SELECT primary_contact_id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (target_account_id,)
        ).fetchone()[0]
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE invoices SET account_id = ?, owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (target_account_id, contact, invoice_id),
        )
    conn.close()
    return f"Invoice {invoice_id} moved to {target_account_id}, owner {contact}"

tools.name: grant_invoice_share_access
tools.description: Gives a user view or edit permission on an invoice by recording a sharing grant with an optional expiry.

params.name: expires_at
params.description: Optional ISO timestamp when access ends

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DB_PATH = "billing.db"


def grant_invoice_share_access(invoice_id, user_id, permission, expires_at=None):
    grant_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    granted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM invoice_grants WHERE invoice_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
                (invoice_id, user_id),
            ) if False else None
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO invoice_grants "
                "(id, invoice_id, user_id, permission, granted_at, expires_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (grant_id, invoice_id, user_id, permission, granted_at, expires_at),
            )
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result = {
        "grant_id": grant_id,
        "invoice_id": invoice_id,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "permission": permission,
        "granted_at": granted_at,
        "expires_at": expires_at,
    }
    return result
